name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an early-stage exploration company focused on acquiring gold royalty interests and mineral properties in the state of Nevada. The company holds an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project within the prolific Walker Lane gold trend, 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada, with the right to earn up to a 50% interest by funding US$5 million in exploration. Nevada Canyon also holds the Olinghouse royalty and other Nevada gold interests, operating a royalty and streaming model distinct from traditional mining and exploration companies.
